# fw tune

> Reference of the fw tune command: CachyOS hardware, sysctl, scx_lavd and ananicy-cpp profiles; x86-64-v3 and mimalloc microbenchmarks. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/tune/

CachyOS hardware, sysctl, scx_lavd and ananicy-cpp profiles; x86-64-v3 and mimalloc microbenchmarks

## Usage

```bash
fw tune <hardware|sysctl|scx|ananicy|bench>
```

## Aliases

`fw cachy` runs `fw tune`.

## Subcommands

```bash
fw tune hardware
fw tune sysctl
fw tune scx
fw tune ananicy
fw tune bench
```

The names come from the usage line.

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
